title: Sebastian and the Echo
author: Tamsin Nystrom
blurb: Mirabel Thackeray, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
